description: The remainder of a negative dividend is negative
notes: The spec calls % the remainder (modulo) without saying which sign the result takes. hashicorp/hcl computes a - b * trunc(a / b), so the result takes the sign of the dividend (Value.Modulo in cty/value_ops.go). For -7 % 3 a truncated remainder gives -1, while floored and Euclidean remainders give 2.
